rows.title: Live only, the person's own token
rows.defect: the live host check is skipped, so a paper or shared-account base URL is accepted
rows.test: a paper host or the Broker API is refused

rows.title: Numbers as strings
rows.defect: the limit price is sent as a JSON number
rows.test: limit_price goes out as a string

rows.title: The order-type matrix
rows.defect: the connector sends every order as a buy
rows.test: the broker receives the side the person said

rows.title: A quote with source and as-of on every card
rows.defect: the quote line is dropped from the card
rows.test: the card names the quote, its source and its time

rows.title: Buying power before a buy
rows.defect: the buying-power check is skipped
rows.test: a $500 buy with $320 stops

rows.title: The position before a sell
rows.defect: the oversell check is skipped
rows.test: selling 9 of 7 shares stops

rows.title: A fresh, single-use, context-bound yes
rows.defect: the confirmation expiry is not enforced
rows.test: a yes after 10 minutes places nothing

rows.title: Partial is partial
rows.defect: partially_filled is mapped to filled
rows.test: half filled reads as partly filled

rows.title: The receipt
rows.defect: the receipt drops the order id
rows.test: the receipt names the order id

rows.title: Market closed means queued
rows.defect: the broker's clock is read but treated as always open
rows.test: a closed market queues and says so

rows.title: A thrown write is never retried blind
rows.defect: a write that threw is retried with a fresh client id
rows.test: a lost response is reconciled, never re-sent

rows.title: A broker refusal is a failure
rows.defect: a definite refusal is treated as an unknown outcome
rows.test: a 403 is failed with the reason

rows.title: Canceled only when the record says so
rows.defect: any read-back after a cancel is reported as canceled
rows.test: pending_cancel is reported as requested

rows.title: LIVE everywhere
rows.defect: the LIVE label is dropped from every surface
rows.test: the card starts with LIVE

rows.title: The broker's order rules before sending
rows.defect: a dollar amount is allowed on a limit order
rows.test: a dollar amount on a limit asks for shares

rows.title: Stop-on-change
rows.defect: the re-verification result is ignored
rows.test: a moved price stops the order

rows.title: Cross-person isolation: the caller's own account
rows.defect: rows are not checked against the caller, so a broken read hands A's request B's older account
rows.test: a leaked row for another person opens nothing

rows.title: The token must open the person's own account
rows.defect: the account the token opens is never compared with the person's row
rows.test: a token for B's account sends nothing for A

rows.title: The token reference is the person's own
rows.defect: the row's vault reference is trusted without checking it names this person and this row
rows.test: a row pointing at another person's secret opens nothing

rows.title: LIVE ONLY at the account layer
rows.defect: a paper row counts as live
rows.test: a paper row is never opened

rows.title: Only built providers are opened
rows.defect: a designed-but-unbuilt provider is opened with the Alpaca adapter
rows.test: a Schwab row is never sent to Alpaca

rows.title: A sale is never carded "No fee."
rows.defect: the adapter stops declaring Alpaca's pass-through sale fees, so a sale is carded "No fee."
rows.test: an Alpaca sell card says SEC and FINRA fees come out

rows.title: A restricted account is said before any card
rows.defect: the adapter stops reading the restriction, so a blocked account is carded and the broker refuses the order after the yes
rows.test: Alpaca's restriction flags and a non-ACTIVE status refuse with the source and time, nothing staged

rows.title: A timing Upmore can't see is named first
rows.defect: the situation note is dropped, so the flow asks the size as if the timing had been understood
rows.test: 'sell my NVDA before earnings' says Upmore has no earnings dates before asking the size

rows.title: Today's change is the broker's own number
rows.defect: the adapter stops reading unrealized_intraday_pl, so today's change is never available
rows.test: 'why is my portfolio down today' sums Alpaca's unrealized_intraday_pl per position, signed and sourced

rows.title: Sizes as people type them
rows.defect: counts in words are not read, so the flow asks the size again
rows.test: 'one share of apple' cards 1 share

rows.title: A limit without $
rows.defect: a limit price without '$' is dropped, so the card is a market order
rows.test: buy 1 VOO limit 500 is a $500 limit

rows.title: A sell card keeps its terms
rows.defect: only the long fee line is tried, so a limit sell falls to the last-resort line
rows.test: sell 1 AAPL at $250 says 1 share and the limit

rows.title: A closed market is always said
rows.defect: the shortest card drops the timing, so a closed-market order reads as if it fills now
rows.test: a short-form card says Works from the open

rows.title: Filler is never a ticker
rows.defect: trailing chat filler stays in the query, so 'VOO thx' is looked up
rows.test: buy $4 of VOO thx cards VOO
